response_text: They work together because the scheduler supports two compatible triggers that feed the same switch path: an explicit yield from a thread and an automatic hand-off when the time slice expires. The tick path resets the budget on expiry, while the yield path resets it when a thread gives up early. Since both converge on the same save/restore and accounting, a yielding thread and a pre-empted thread interleave cleanly.\n
